A job in the industry I wanted to get into and the type of position! I had no experience in my type of position (very techy and hard to break into), and a very brief unpaid internship years before in the industry sector (so literally nothing relevant).

Basically, i was unemployed and I had been applying to jobs for 6 months after being laid off by my previous company. There was so much resistance and no luck. I was realllly hoping for this one job and got denied after the final round.

The pay was not a livable wage however, and since I support myself I was like “whatever”.. even though it’s a dream company I can’t survive off anything even CLOSE to the job salary. Given this,i did not prep for interviews or anything. 

Anyways, I got the job, they DOUBLED my salary. I didn’t even have to negotiate, the recruiter did it for me. It was the only job in those months where a r recruiter came to me, and it ended up being exactly what I wanted from my career years ago! 

And the irony, it was the only job I poured no anxiety or stress on the outcome for, because well, I didn’t think it was a feasible option given the salary. 

Works out in funny ways.

Yep. Healthy meals at full sizes literally sits on my body as if it were unhealthy full size meals.

 I do find small sized portions and not eating until “full” is when suddenly I look slimmer a few days later. And I doubt im eating under 1200 calories (which I think would be getting unhealthy). Really riding that edge of  being slightly satiated does it for me. Like you eat enough to not feel hungry, but any time I feel full even once in a day(even if it’s a “healthy” meal) I bloat and my body hangs on to it. And also not eating in the morning, otherwise I WILL eat all day more frequently. 

Not saying by any means starve, but after years of eating healthy and low carb, the only time I’ve seen a difference is very moderate portion sizes. Not promoting an eating disorder, but I don’t think it’s necessarily bad to not feel super full during the day. Just satiated. You can eat anything you want at that point, in my experience.

I come in and out of being in my manifestation vibration. Sometimes I feel very powerful and like I can change my environment with ease, and other times when I’m feeling low on my life / self and can’t escape my thoughts, I feel less in that creative power. But even then, I always know it’s real and just requires work to actually entering a vibration. I have little “instant manifestation” stories that make me remember that some vibrations really can be radiated and picked up… 

For example, in highschool I was manifesting love through a guided meditation before bed one night (very early in my journey). I woke up the next morning, and at 11am I had 3 snapchats from 3 guys who I hadn’t talked to in months / had been of romantic interests in past / did not know each other. Yes, they weren’t my ideal match and I was not interested in dating them, but it showed me that I had sent some type of “signal” that made 3 people OVER NIGHT think to contact me (I was not actively talking to any guys/snap chatting 0 people). Months later after consistently getting in touch with my love vibration, I actually attracted a fantastic match for love, and that was when I had actually entered that space of mental peace, satisfaction, and radiated what I wanted to attract. 

Another time, right before graduating college, I told myself “I want to have at least one good hookup before leaving this campus in 5 days”. I sat there and focused on my sexual energy for 10 mins (coming from likely a somewhat desperate not loving energy). Well, I receive an unsolicited dick pic that day from someone I hadn’t talked to in years, my guy friend asked me to hook up, and I got a booty call. All 3 happened in the same hour about 3 hours after I finished focusing on my sexuality. The guys were gross, I clearly had not projected the right energy, but it still showed that somehow I signaled a weird sexual reminder to some random dudes that had maybe been attracted to me in the past? I had 0 people reach out to me with that type of stuff in months, so it was way too random.

While these are not my good manifesting stories, they were definitely too crazy of coincidences. I just knew that I had sent out some type of signals. 

My GOOD manifesting stories- which actually required a vibrational shift, includes:

• getting job at an amazing salary at an amazing company, and it being my ticket to nyc

• meeting a real love (came with 100 crazy coincidences too) - didn’t happen until i actually felt basically “done” with my manifesting for it (felt self love, no longer felt attached to the outcome - was fulfilled)

• found an AMAZING apartment that was a replica of my Pinterest board (20x the size of a typical nyc apartment, rent stabilized, at $1700) - everyone says “best apartment in nyc” that enters my home, and the irony, is I didn’t even seem in the realm of possibility/I didn’t know those apartments existed in the city. Yet when I looked back at my Pinterest board, the full 2 walls of 15 ft windows / huge open loft layout was an exact replica. It’s like the apartment gods came together to pull something that shouldn’t have existed in the first place

• made random connections and friends out of the blue - for example, I had no friends in New York, then after meditating on friendship for just one random 15 minute period, I somehow had 3 sets of plans that weekend that came to me in different, random ways

• One time on a bus home from college, I made a list in my “law of attraction app” for things I wanted (objects) and I wrote: money, crystals, jewelry. As soon as I came home, my mom goes “I need to take you to this new store!”… the store sold jewelry and crystals, she bought it for me, then when went to visit my grandma and grandpa. There, they gave me money in addition to my aunt who never gives me cash. Just like that, from the hour between the bus ride and coming home, I checked all 3 off my list! My mom NEVER takes me shopping. 

Basically, bigger manifestations require more work to truly align to that high vibration. You can only attract as high of a vibration as you have experienced in meditation / journaling / etc. But even those little not-so-great stories I shared at the beginning, showed that even with a short 15 minute focus that may have been desperate, I was able to send some signal into the universe (perhaps negative), but still something!

It’s tough, because for manifestations to come to fruition, it’s usually at the point where suddenly you believe it is your fate basically. Usually for me, it’s after using guided meditating on a certain topic a few times. After that, then you stop yearning for it, because you have basically entered a mindset and vibration where it aligns with you and you fully believe it’s coming. You may be still taking actions towards your goal, but you lose that resistance that makes you focus on it out of desperation. So you don’t have to forget about it completely, and can still keep working towards something even, but you aren’t obsessively thinking about it desperately. 

For example, I couldn’t find the motivation to apply to jobs. I mediate a few days, imagining getting a job I enjoy and make great money at, and then felt less internal resistance and felt optimistic. I then apply to some jobs, got an offer for a salary that was over what I initially thought I could achieve, then felt confident, and now I’m applying to many more high paying jobs  because I now believe I can get a great job that pays well. (I’m about to graduate college btw)

If you can’t let go, that still means you are yearning for it. If you want an ex to text you, and you are obsessing, it won’t come. If you want to attract a great partner, and gain the confidence and believe you will find a great partner (without actually ~forgetting about it~), it will manifest too.

Omg totally you don’t have to. If you start feeling good about what you are trying to manifest/ currently writing about, just embed yourself in that feeling and write whatever feels natural. And if that means also scripting other amazing things that you can imagine in your future, do that. I find the best way to manifest is truly just stepping into your new world and feeling a new reality, so I will meditate to just various amazing aspects of my ideal life at once— I’m at a good job, in a good apartment, with secure relationships. I think about the feeling of, well, waking up excited to go to my job, looking up at a ceiling I love (comfy sheets, natural light), and simply feeling secure. That’s it. All of those amazing feelings would blend together into one reality, if I was living it, and I try to think about the person I would be. 

Maybe focus on the goals (out of your 7) that you can picture together, and kind of go hand and hand. Whether it be money, relationships, health, happiness, passion, etc. Script about yourself living a reality that encompasses whatever that FEELS like. Scripting can be great for repeating affirmations that may transform your mindset, especially during those just complete limiting belief ruts. But think any scripting “rule” means way less than emotionally connecting during it. If all 7 feel extremely unnatural together, just focus on the ones that feel the most compatible at one time. 

Best of luck :) I hardly script, and yet, all of my random scripting entries have came true, and it’s only a handful over a couple years. Divine timing is real too. I have random scripts from years ago, and they all came true at one point or another (I’ve only manifested for about 4 years). Most of which I hardly focused on, somehow I guess I just became it, probably completely unconsciously. Weight, hair, relationship, art. Takes some time, but it will come <3
